title: An updated protocol for the cost-effective and weekend-free culture of human induced pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Prepare AA2P solution.
Add 35 mL of sterile Milli-Q water into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 7 mL of HCl (1 N) to the conical tube.
Weigh 20 g of L-ascorbic acid 2-phosphate and add it to the Falcon tube.
Mix vigorously for 10 minutes or until dissolved on a rocker at 50 rpm.
Ensure final volume is 50 mL with pH adjusted to 7.1.
Prepare insulin solution.
Place 48 mL of sterile Milli-Q water into a 50 mL conical tube.
Weigh 0.5 g of insulin and add it to the conical tube.
Add 400 μL of HCl (1 N) and mix by inversion until clear.
Add 550 μL of NaOH (1 N) and mix by inversion until solution is clear.
Place 47 mL of sterile Milli-Q water into a 50 mL conical tube.
Weight 0.5 g of transferrin and add into the tube, mix by inversion until clear.
Add 1 mL of 2 mg/mL sodium selenite solution to the mixture.
Add 1 mL of 4 mg/mL FGF2 solution to the mixture.
Add 40 μL of 250 μg/mL TGFB3 solution to the mixture.
Mix by inversion until solution is clear.
In a cell culture hood, add three tubes (AA2P, insulin, and B5) along with 50 mL of sterile Milli-Q water to a sterile bottle and mix.
Add the 200 mL solution to a 250 mL bottle-top PES filter for sterilization.
Make 2 mL B8 supplement aliquots in sterile 2 mL microtubes.
Freeze B8 supplement aliquots at -20°C.
Thaw one B8 supplement aliquot in a cell culture hood when needed.
Add the thawed aliquot to 1 L of 4°C DMEM/F12 and mix by inversion.
Keep the media at 4°C and avoid exposure to light.
Thaw one B8 supplement aliquot and add it to 1 L of 4°C DMEM/F12.
Thaw one aliquot of thiazovivin and add it to 1 L of 4°C DMEM/F12.
Mix the media by inversion.
Store the mixed media at 4°C and avoid exposure to light.
Transfer a 6-well Matrigel-coated plate from the incubator to the cell culture hood.
Aspirate the Matrigel solution from 3 of the wells.
Add 2 mL of B8T medium into each of the aspirated wells.
Transfer a vial of hiPSCs from liquid nitrogen into a 37°C water bath.
Keep the cells in the water bath until only a sliver of ice remains.
Use a 10 mL pipette to remove the contents from the vial.
Fill the pipette with 10 mL of B8T medium, and use this to remove the contents of the vial.
Transfer approximately 5 mL to a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash out the vial with approximately 1 mL of medium, and transfer the remainder to the conical tube.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 200 × g.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL B8T.

Transfer the resuspended cells to three B8T-containing wells of the Matrigel-coated 6-well plate from step 16 at a 1:2 (1 mL of cell suspension), 1:3 (670 μL of cell suspension), and 1:6 ratios (330 μL of cell suspension).
Return the plate to the incubator.
Exchange medium with B8 medium every 24 h until wells become 70%–80% confluent.
Adjust the split ratio to 1:12 to 1:20 when cells reach 70%–80% confluence.
Passage hiPSCs when they reach 70%–80% confluence.
Differentiate hiPSCs according to specific cell needs and experimental design.
Aspirate cell culture medium.
Add 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA per well and incubate for 6 min at room temperature.
Aspirate Matrigel solution from two new 6-well plates.
Replace with 1 mL of B8T medium per well.
Aspirate EDTA from the well after 6 minutes.
Add 1 mL of B8T medium to the well.
Blast medium against cell surface to dissociate cells and detach them from the Matrigel layer.
Avoid pipetting cells too much as it decreases cell survival after passaging.
Top up well with B8T medium for the desired split ratio.
Remove specified volume of cell solution before topping up: For 1:20, remove 250 μl; For 1:24, remove 400 μl.
Add 1 ml of cell solution per well to two new Matrigel-coated 6-well plates for a final volume of 2 ml per well.
Prepare the freezing solution by combining 5 ml DMSO with 45 ml B8T medium in a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Mix the freezing solution by inverting before use.
Aspirate culture medium from cells at 70%-80% confluence.
Add 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA per well.
Incubate for 6 minutes at room temperature (inside the cell culture hood).
Aspirate EDTA from the wells.
With a P1000 tip, add 1 mL of B8T medium to the wells.
Pipette up and down about 5 times to dissociate cells and detach them from the Matrigel layer.
Transfer the cells to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of freezing solution per well.
Transfer each cell suspension to a cryovial.
Place the cryovial(s) in a Coolcell (or other cell-freezing container).
Move the cryovial(s) quickly to a −80°C freezer.
After 2–24 hours in −80°C, transfer cells to liquid nitrogen storage.
Passage the cells on the morning of day 1 (Monday).
Seed the cells at a ratio of 1:12 to 1:15 in B8T medium.
Change the media to B8 medium on the morning of day 2 (Tuesday).
Add 2 mL per well.
Skip media change on day 3 (Wednesday).
Split the cells and seed them at a ratio of 1:20 in B8T medium on the afternoon of day 4 (Thursday).
Change media to B8 medium on the afternoon of day 5 (Friday).
Add 2 mL per well.
Skip media change on day 6 (Saturday) and day 7 (Sunday).
Passage the cells on the morning of day 8/day 1 at a 1:20 ratio in B8T medium.
